scope: Bounded OFFLINE sole-aligned stance-COM trajectory optimization98v2. Original unexecuted98 draft assumed a world-x shift, corrected after97 showed the rotated sole boundary; no original draft model evaluations or simulations ran. Audited91/95 held the sagittal center-of-mass target at the original nearest inset left-sole point while the right foot moved140mm backward. Diagnosis97 measures unused rearward range within that SAME sole and5.5mm target reserve. Add one sole-longitudinal rearward COM-target parameter bounded0–80mm and by the exact inset polygon; coupled initial/landing crouch and temporary roll retain their prior bounds. No temporary pitch bump. The endpoint89, fixed feet/arms, commanded14fingers,38deg model/40deg physical tilt,3mm housing/foot tolerances,.5deg foot attitude,5mm modeled support,.031rad IK reserve,.03rad command margin,effort limits and.15rad/s are unchanged. At most40unique63-knot coarse evaluations/10iterations plusone115-knot dense check. This is a diagnosed path/support revision, not a gain/rate/arm sweep. All seat loading remains explicitly assumed only at zero gap; commanded force realization, actual clamp/filter, sensed support and dynamics remain unchecked. No simulation, PPO, holdout or physical admission
